# Next Story

> Headless CMS demo and public learning project built with Next.js App Router and Storyblok. Working examples connect content modelling, server rendering, draft preview, cache invalidation, and read-only agent access to their source.

- Site: https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/
- Source: https://github.com/marcop135/nextstory (MIT)
- Author: Marco Pontili, https://marcopontili.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/): publishing-flow illustration and editable content/code ownership comparison
- [How it works](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/how-it-works): content model, draft preview, publish webhook, and cache tags, step by step
- [Blocks](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/blocks): every Storyblok block on the site, labelled with its component name
- [German home](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/de): German routes served from Storyblok field-level translations
- [Privacy](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/privacy): cookieless self-hosted Matomo, Vercel hosting
- [For agents](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/for-agents): copyable reading workflows, resource inventory, and read-only browser tools

## Reading resources

- [Home Markdown](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/content/index.md): published content with canonical URL and source
- [German home Markdown](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/content/de/index.md): read German content directly
- [Block metadata](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/content/blocks.json): page blocks, translatable fields, and schema/component source paths
- [Portal Markdown](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/content/for-agents.md): reading and inspection workflows
- [OpenAPI](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/openapi.json): public HTTP resources
- [API catalog](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/.well-known/api-catalog): resource discovery linkset
- [Skills index](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): concrete reading workflows
- [Access](https://nextstory.marcopontili.com/auth.md): public read access; authenticated CMS operations are separate
- [Architecture](https://github.com/marcop135/nextstory/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): content delivery and resource design
- [Development cycle](https://github.com/marcop135/nextstory/blob/main/docs/development-cycle.md): setup, checks, versions, annotated tags, deployment, and CMS publication

Use /content/{slug}.md for a published page, including /content/de/{slug}.md for German. HTML and Markdown have separate URLs. Native WebMCP is feature-detected; HTTP resources work without browser support. Public Markdown always returns published content, including when editor preview cookies are present.
